commitResults.messageBody:
Tasks do not retain a completion state or support status changes.

Introduce a Task model with done status and use it for task storage.

Display status icons in list output.

Support mark and unmark commands so users can track task completion.

commitResults.messageTitle: Task types: Add todos, deadlines, and events
commitResults.messageBody:
The task list supports only generic tasks and cannot retain date or time details.

Add Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses and parse their commands into the shared Task array. Keep date and time values as strings until the later date-handling increment.

Invalid commands can crash the chatbot or produce unclear feedback.

Raise BaemaxException for malformed task commands, invalid task numbers, blank input, and unknown commands.

Show friendly Baemax-specific messages while keeping valid commands running.

commitResults.messageTitle: Tasks: Add deletion and collection storage
commitResults.messageBody:
Users need to remove obsolete tasks without restarting Baemax.

Store tasks in an ArrayList so deletion shifts remaining tasks safely and the list can grow dynamically.

Validate delete task numbers with the existing exception-based command handling.
